accept.why: The player's bar is docked over the stack's foot: a route must be a child of the navigation root, so the bar cannot take room of its own. The home list and Recent leave room under their last row while it shows; the full player's sheet and the hymn page (other units' files) do not yet (follow-up of ex-hy-player).
As bar-title: the docked bar over the full player's and the hymn page's last rows, until each leaves room under it.

A chord is tapped where it is printed, over its syllable at the words' size, as in the current hymnal: a box of 44 pt (24 px on the web) would push every chorded line apart or cover the next chord's tap, and the chord's place over its syllable is the feature (ex-hy-chords findings, the chord's tap).
